            Meet Oceans Salon

            Our commitment

            Oceans Salon

            Oceans Salon is a hair salon at 1326 W Broad St in Bethlehem. Its own booking page calls it a sanctuary where everyone is welcome, with stylists skilled across a diverse range of hair types and textures. The team is Devon Pickering, Tom Doyle, and Zoe Bruce.

            The salon offers haircuts, hair coloring, perms, hair treatments, and styling and updos. Booking runs online through GlossGenius, under Devon Pickering's page.
